title: $847 Million Powerball. The Winner Actually Keeps…
description:
A single Powerball ticket in New Jersey won $847 million on November 4, 2026. But the winner won't keep $847 million. Cash option, federal and New Jersey taxes, the real odds, and what $6 a week in stocks instead of tickets turned into since 2000.

0:00 Cold open
1:20 The cash option
2:04 The tax bill
3:11 Still insane money
3:36 The odds
4:34 The Mongki backtest
6:17 Three choices
7:01 Outro

Sources:
- KBTX / Gray News, Nov 5, 2026: jackpot, cash value, odds, rank
- New Jersey Division of Taxation: lottery withholding (8% over $500,000)
- NBC Philadelphia: federal 24% withholding, 37% top bracket, NJ 10.75% top rate
- Daily price data: Yahoo Finance (SPY, QQQ, BRK-B, KO)

Tax figures are rough estimates on top rates, before deductions. Not financial, tax or legal advice. For education only.
